title: GTA 6 on PC could arrive sooner
seoTitle: GTA 6 on PC may launch earlier
subtitle: Console price hikes may pressure Rockstar to release the game on PC sooner
excerpt: Console price hikes could cause Rockstar to launch GTA 6 on PC earlier, a welcome news for PC gamers.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Console price hikes could cause Rockstar to launch GTA 6 on PC earlier. This could be good news for PC players who are eager to play the game.

What’s happening with GTA 6

GTA 6 is slated for a November release on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, but the PC version still lacks an official launch date. However, the rise in console prices may pressure Rockstar to bring the game to PC sooner.

How console price hikes could affect GTA 6’s PC release

Higher console prices might push more gamers toward PC, prompting Rockstar to release the PC version earlier to meet that demand. Additionally, Rockstar could align the PC launch with the debut of the new GTA Online version, ensuring a large simultaneous player base.

What PC gamers can expect

PC players can anticipate GTA 6 arriving with advanced graphical features and a gameplay experience comparable to the console versions. Moreover, Rockstar may leverage performance‑enhancing technologies such as NVIDIA’s DLSS and AMD’s FSR to ensure the game runs well on non‑high‑end rigs.

Other PC game releases

Besides GTA 6, other PC releases that gamers can look forward to include *Gears of War: E-Day*, *Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4*, and *NBA 2K27*. These titles promise immersive gameplay and impressive graphics for PC audiences.

With information from Eurogamer.pt, TecMundo.
